clauses.clause: Infected animals read as enemies (lion snarl, wounds visible from the iso camera); zebra legs clean at PO zooms; player readable at night (rim/accents).
clauses.note: Personally inspected40 healthy/infected panels: all5species ×2tiers ×2POzooms. Infected lion has open toothy mouth, red eyes and red rib wounds; elephant/gorilla have torn rib patches, zebra retains four separate clean legs/striping, flamingo has distinct thin legs and angular damaged body. Red bars/ground attacks distinguish enemies; courier accents/rim remain legible against dark sanctuary. Presentation fixture starts without carried gunmen, one ordinary runner causes same-ID conversion, protected courier only; no population/rate claim.
